title: On the Existence of Hyperelliptic Curves over $\mathbb{Q}(T)$ with Certain Jacobian Ranks
summary: Let $y^2 = f(x,T)$ be a hyperelliptic curve of genus $g\geq 1$, defined over $\mathbb{Q}(T)$. We prove the existence of infinitely many imaginary hyperelliptic curves with a fixed genus $g$ having a certain rank for $5\leq r\leq 4g+2$, and a similar result for real hyperelliptic curves with a fixed genus $g$ having a certain rank for $6\leq r\leq 4g+4$. We begin by constructing such curves and prove the rank using two methods.
